name: Hannah Kowalski
title: Data Analyst and Analytics Engineer - SQL, dashboards, pipelines
bio: I’m Hannah Kowalski, a Data Analyst and Analytics Engineer specialising in SQL, dashboards and data pipelines. With a background in economics and statistics, I help businesses turn raw data into clear, actionable insights – from building automated reporting for online retailers to uncovering claim leakage for insurers. Over the past five years I’ve delivered 50+ freelance contracts, creating end‑to‑end solutions that save time and drive growth. I enjoy explaining complex analysis in plain language so that every stakeholder, technical or not, can make confident decisions.
